tldr: Uranus through the 12th house disrupts rest, retreat, privacy, hidden pressure, and endings.
body:
When Uranus moves through your 12th house, it interrupts the usual pattern around rest, retreat, privacy, hidden pressure, exhaustion, endings, and what you are not ready to explain. You may notice what is happening out of sight: fatigue, unfinished feelings, private pressure, or the need to step back before you can understand what comes next.

You may need more space, honesty, freedom, experimentation, or a break from the old setup. It can help you see where the current pattern has become too small or too false.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for giving yourself space to process what cannot be solved by pushing harder.

The caution: Watch for changing everything just to get relief from one pressure point. The risk is disappearing into avoidance when what you really need is rest, honesty, and quiet support.

Uranus moves through this house for a long chapter. Give change room without throwing away the parts of life that still matter.
